summary: Scanbox SC moves to the twice-daily pipeline and now also collects fixed findings since the last run. A new ingestor adds them to the yearly history customers see.

chapters.title: Reading fixes since the last run
chapters.text: The collector keeps a cursor of the last fix time it saw and asks the appliance only for findings fixed after it, one query per time window. The ingestor adds those fixes to the yearly history.

chapters.title: Schedule, config and tests
chapters.text: The pipeline schedule moves to every 12 hours, the backfill default is one year, and tests cover the new windows.

chapters.title: Documentation
chapters.text: The collector docs describe the cursor and the twice-daily schedule.
